name: GitHub (sign-in wrapper)
description: GitHub API server with built-in sign-in. Wraps MissionSquad/mcp-github and adds login, status and logout tools, so the user signs in through GitHub's device flow instead of creating and pasting a personal access token. Repo and file operations, issues, pull requests and search. Use for 'sign in to GitHub', 'open an issue', 'list my pull requests', 'search repositories'.
summary: GitHub repo, issue, PR and search tools with a built-in device-flow login: no token to create or paste.

transports.description: GitHub wrapper (stdio): sign-in tools plus the upstream GitHub server.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to GitHub. Prints a link and a short code, opens the browser, and blocks until the user approves, declines or the code expires. Dispatch it as a concurrent task with a reminder, and tell the user to open the link and enter the code when it appears in the output. Returns who signed in; the token is never returned.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report whether JARVIS is signed in to GitHub, and as whom. No network call.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Forget the stored GitHub sign-in on this machine. Does not revoke the token at GitHub.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a file in a repository.

tools.name: push_files
tools.description: Push multiple files in a single commit.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get contents of a file or directory.

tools.name: get_pull_request_files
tools.description: List files changed in a pull request.

configurableProperties.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
configurableProperties.description: Optional. A token set by hand wins over the stored sign-in. Leave empty and use the login tool instead.

configurableProperties.label: GitHub OAuth App client id
configurableProperties.description: Optional. Overrides the built-in public client id of the JarvisOS GitHub OAuth App. Public, not a secret.

checks: wrapper: first-party stdlib Python in this repository; shared sign-in helper vendored from servers/_lib, identical copy enforced by the PR gate
upstream: MissionSquad/mcp-github fetched by setup.sh at pinned commit e312daffca07981c02aa8ca13a9dee82ad51697c, HEAD verified against the pin; build: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build
network (wrapper): HTTPS to github.com and api.github.com only; verification links and redirects are host-pinned
secrets: the token is stored in the OS keyring (secret-tool) or an owner-only file; it is never returned in a tool result or logged
login prints a link and device code to stderr and opens the browser; it sends no secret
trust.notes: Replaces the PAT-only io.github.missionsquad.mcp-github entry for users who want to sign in rather than paste a token. The tool list is the same minimal subset as that entry plus login/status/logout; the upstream exposes more tools, which the host floor classifies.
trust.securityNotes: Powerful GitHub API access, repo scope by default. Sign in with the least privilege you need; a token set by hand in config takes precedence over the stored sign-in.
